editorial_thesis: The next practical advantage is not a smarter single agent; it is a better operating surface for choosing models, planning together, compressing context, and keeping execution inside a controlled boundary.

topic_groups.title: Multi-model Orchestration Economics
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh GitHub research preview makes model routing and selective escalation concrete, extending yesterday’s agent-systems measurement lane into a practical cost-and-quality control surface.

sources.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
sources.why_selected: It operationalizes routing, critique, and escalation across a model portfolio.
sources.usefulness: Use the pattern to design Buildn task routing around expected outcome per dollar, not model loyalty.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot monthly enterprise roundup — September 2026
sources.why_selected: It places multi-model orchestration alongside agent apps and workflow surfaces.
sources.usefulness: Use it as a map of where orchestration is entering normal delivery tooling.

topic_groups.title: Collaborative Agent Planning
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Chopin is a new research prototype in a neglected lane: shared planning and decision traceability before agents write code.

sources.title: Chopin — a real-time multiplayer, agentic planning environment
sources.why_selected: It joins human presence, shared plans, chat, and MCP in one planning surface.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a Buildn planning artifact that preserves decisions before delegated execution.

sources.title: GitHub Next Projects
sources.why_selected: The project is listed as an active September 2026 research prototype.
sources.usefulness: Track adjacent experiments without treating prototypes as production promises.

topic_groups.title: Context Engineering for Humans + Agents
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Knowledge Compressor and WikiKB point to a practical knowledge gap: repository-native context that is smaller, inspectable, and curated for both people and agents.

sources.title: Knowledge Compressor
sources.why_selected: It tests how far documentation can shrink while preserving answer quality.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark compaction on Buildn runbooks before paying for larger context windows.

sources.title: WikiKB: a fast, repository-native knowledge base for people and agents
sources.why_selected: It makes knowledge explicit, versioned, and close to the repository.
sources.usefulness: Use a curated markdown knowledge layer for client conventions, decisions, and agent instructions.

topic_groups.title: Self-hosted Agent Execution
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Coder Agents GA is a concrete infrastructure signal for regulated or privacy-sensitive workflows: agent and execution can stay on customer-controlled infrastructure while models remain replaceable.

sources.title: Coder Agents is GA: Fully Self-Hosted, From Agent to Execution
sources.why_selected: It turns self-hosted agent execution from a beta concept into a generally available platform offer.
sources.usefulness: Compare its control-plane/workspace split with Hermes and Buildn worker boundaries.

sources.title: Introducing Agent Relay: Cloud-hosted agents, self-hosted execution
sources.why_selected: It separates agent UX from execution locality instead of forcing an all-cloud or all-local choice.
sources.usefulness: Use the split when clients need vendor ergonomics but cannot export code or secrets.
